name: Orcs of Mordick
source:
A war is tearing our once tight nations, and we need all able (and endowed) men and orc...to join in our fight! Sarudude, fallen elven wizard, now The Warlock King...seeks to force our fair land Mordick, to it's knees, by waging war upon all of Middle Girth itself. And Mordick, doesn't just get-down for anyone, OK! 


That's where YOU come in, General Tallihoe, legendary leader of one of the various human kingdoms / resistances. Amass your own orc army, to square off against Sarudude's, using The Ring's power of glamor. Save Middle Girth, and maybe make some green-love along the way. 

[From [url=https://soulsoftea.itch.io/orcsofmordick]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场战争正在撕裂我们曾经紧张的国家，我们需要所有有能力（且有天赋）的男人和兽人……加入我们的战斗！萨鲁德，堕落的精灵巫师，现在的术士之王……试图通过对整个中环发动战争来迫使我们美丽的土地莫迪克屈服。还有莫迪克，他不会为任何人而沮丧，好吧！


这就是你登场的地方，塔利霍将军，各个人类王国/抵抗组织之一的传奇领袖。集结你自己的兽人军队，利用至尊魔戒的魅力力量与萨鲁德的军队对峙。保留中腰，也许还能一路上做一些绿色之爱。

[来自[url=https://soulsoftea.itch.io/orcsofmordick]Itch.io[/url]]
